records.text: and flight will perish from the runner, the mighty one will certainly not maintain his strength, and the fighter will certainly not save his life,
and the archer will certainly not stand, the swift of foot will certainly not be saved, nor will the horseman save his life,
and he will find his heart among powers; the naked one will pursue on that day,” says the Lord.
Simon, Simon, behold, Satan demanded to have you all, to sift you like wheat.
But I prayed for you, that your faith might not fail; and you, once you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”
He said to Him, “Lord, I am ready to go with Thee both to prison and to death.”
But He said, “I tell you, Peter, a rooster will not crow today until you deny three times that you know Me.”
